achievements.name: Start Boost
achievements.detail: Rev on every count of the countdown and leave the grid with a full start boost.

achievements.name: Skimboost
achievements.detail: Drive past a slowed teammate and flick them back up to speed.

achievements.name: Slingshot
achievements.detail: Ride the trail behind a leading teammate, then break out of it for a boost.

achievements.name: Team Ultimate
achievements.detail: Fill the shared meter and fire a Team Ultimate during a race.

achievements.name: Triple Stunt
achievements.detail: Flip three times before landing a single jump.

achievements.name: Red Burst
achievements.detail: Catch a rival in a Red Burst flame trail so they spin out.

achievements.name: Garage Part
achievements.detail: Buy a part from the Mod Pods and fit it on a car in the garage.

achievements.name: Mod Credits
achievements.detail: Spend 5,000 credits at the Mod Pods.

achievements.name: Ring Haul
achievements.detail: Pick up 20,000 rings across your races.

achievements.name: Chapter One
achievements.detail: Clear the opening chapter of Team Adventure.

achievements.name: Hard Chapter
achievements.detail: Win every event in one Team Adventure chapter on Hard.

achievements.name: Every Star
achievements.detail: Earn every star on offer in Team Adventure.

achievements.name: Last Chapter
achievements.detail: Finish the final chapter of Team Adventure.
